title: GameCommand
description: Industrial standard schema for console commands, GM scripts, and cheats in L-MOD Vault.

syntax_type.description: The execution environment and syntax paradigm of the command.

code.description: The exact executable command string, function invocation, or parameter format.

desc.description: Detailed explanation of what the command does, benefits to player, and caveats.

min_version.description: Minimum verified game patch or framework version (e.g., 'v1.0.8+', 'CET 2.13', 'UE4SS 3.0+').

framework_required.description: Prerequisite runtime framework or console injector (e.g., 'UE4SS', 'Cyber Engine Tweaks', 'None (Native Console)').
